cells.A2: Updated 22 Oct 2026. Savers put away ₹100 a day by UPI into mutual funds in their own name (80% equity, 20% debt); we earn fund fees and, as a loan marketplace, referral fees from lenders. 9 in 10 savers come online, pan-India; 1 in 10 through doorstep agents in NCR. The app never holds anyone's money.
